violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw sausage stored above vegetables, inside the walk-in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. Raw sausages relocated to a lower shelving. (CORRECTED)

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: sticky rice, red curry, Panange, sweet stick rice.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. (CORRECTED) Proper dates placed on cooked and prepared foods to show preparation dates.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. Bottle of insecticide stored among canned and other dry goods on a shelving in the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. CORRECTED. Insecticide was relocated away from food supplies.

violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. Replace the missing self-closing device on the back donor, and install the screen in proper place to prevent entry of insects and other pests into the food preparation and storage areas. violations.title: Sewage Disposal System, Approved
violations.observation: Observed improper maintenance of sewage from the grease trap. Observed Strong odor emitting from the grease trap, in the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: The GREASE TRAP is required to be cleaned regularly and properly maintained, to prevent unsanitary conditions. Resolve this problem immediately, within the next 3 days.

violations.title: Premises Free of Unnecessary Items/Equipment

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. Unmarked spray bottles toxic cleaning chemicals noted in the ware washing area.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. CORRECTED

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: SPICES, SAUCE, SALT, SUGAR, OIL, in unmarked containers .
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CORRECTED.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. BOXES AND BAGS OPF FOOD SUPPLIES WERE OBSERRVED STORED DIRECTLY ON THE FLOOR IN THE WALK-IN FREEZER AND WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage.

violations.title: Jewelry
violations.observation: Employees observed wearing jewelry on their arms and hands while preparing food. AN EMPLOYEE WAS NOTED WEARING BRACELET.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall limit their jewelry to a plain wedding ring while preparing food. Food employees may not wear bracelets, watches, etc. because they can inhibit proper hand washing. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION. Thai Mom (Inspection Date: 05/16/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean

violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. Clean these surfaces properly and more frequently.
